scope: Remove guessed club-logo requests and omit list-only scalar overfetch while preserving the compact DTO, canonical privacy projection, and fresh detail authorization. Diagnose source readiness separately; do not claim a fix for unreproduced failures.
stageOrder: baseline 100/5000 diagnostic observations and original-loader probes
narrow list scalar reads and harden legacy logo-key lookup
freeze final candidate; full ordinary/Auth/concurrency/browser validation
final BA/AB cold/warm comparison at 100/1000/5000 including every failure
constraints: No production configuration, schema/index, deployment, merge, authorization cache or synthetic loading delay. Use reserved disposable local stack.

measurement.failurePolicy: Retain every preparation and measured outcome, do not replace failures. New input diagnostics are non-sensitive state/counts/phase/timing only.
measurement.fixture: Three separate synthetic navigation actors and clubs in the same reserved stack. Every build in a cohort uses exactly the same rows; no fixture shrink or guard bypass. Each applicant has the Phase 3 rich profile/essay/review fixture.
measurement.finalProtocol: Two matched BA/AB blocks, five measured observations and one fixed warmup per path/condition/build/block. Record all failures including preparation. No tests/builds during collection.
measurement.initialPageMetric: Time from starting document navigation to existing visible useful-content predicate, recorded before request drain. It is a DOM readiness proxy. Preparation elapsed time includes background drain and must not be called initial-content time.
measurement.intermediate: The logo-only 5000 stage is descriptive, separate from the final paired baseline/candidate study. Its initial legacy-key lookup was hardened before the final candidate; the fixture UUID fallback behavior is identical.

paginationDecision: Server cursor pagination remains a separate next-phase contract: current whole-selection quick review, voting pools, per-reviewer score visibility and anonymous ordering must remain complete. This phase narrows SQL width without changing those selection semantics; it does not bound row count.
